parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $\frac{\mathrm dy}{\mathrm dx}=(-\frac23)(3x-1)^{-4/3}\times3$. — B1. Guidance: Expect $-2(3x-1)^{-4/3}$. When $x=\frac23$, $y=2$ soi, $\frac{\mathrm dy}{\mathrm dx}=-2$. — B1B1. Guidance: Second B1 dependent on correct expression for $\frac{\mathrm dy}{\mathrm dx}$. Equation of normal is $y-2=\frac12(x-\frac23)$. — M1. Guidance: Line through $(\frac23,\text{their }2)$ and with gradient $-1/m$. Dependent on $m$ from differentiation. $y=\frac12x+\frac53$. — A1. Total 5.
